entries.definition: in deplorable condition
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Wears the deplorable condition on the surface, making it look pitiable rather than shameful, where *derelict* makes it a reproach.

entries.definition: of metal e.g.
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Damage as deformation rather than breakage: the shape has gone but not necessarily the use, which *broken* denies outright.

entries.definition: in deplorable condition
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Names the deplorable state as something that has given way, plainer and more mechanical than *tatterdemalion*.

entries.definition: out of working order (‘busted’ is an informal substitute for ‘broken’)
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: A verdict on function alone: the thing does not work, and the word says nothing about how it got there, where *battered* says little else.

entries.definition: out of working order (‘busted’ is an informal substitute for ‘broken’)
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The informal substitute for *broken*, and the drop in register makes the same failure sound offhand rather than serious.

entries.definition: of metal e.g.
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Deformation taken across the whole of a thing rather than along one line, so it reads as more thorough than *bent* while judging just as little.
examples: a car with a crumpled front end

entries.definition: harmed or injured or spoiled
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The family's flat baseline: harm has occurred, and the word passes no verdict on the state it left, where *dilapidated* passes little else.
examples: the storm left a wake of badly damaged buildings

entries.definition: of metal e.g.
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The most local of these three - one blow's worth of deformation, where *crumpled* takes the whole surface.

entries.definition: in deplorable condition
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Condemning rather than descriptive - the deplorable state reads as neglect that was allowed to happen, where *dented* is only a fact about a shape.

entries.definition: in deplorable condition
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The formal word for the deplorable state, presenting it as advanced and cumulative decay rather than the single mishap *dented* records.

entries.definition: in deplorable condition
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Adds precariousness to the deplorable state - the thing is not merely poor but barely holding together, which *damaged* never implies.

entries.definition: in deplorable condition
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The most ornate word in this set, and the flourish makes the contempt sound almost relished beside plain *broken-down*.

entries.definition: in deplorable condition
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Plain-spoken where *tatterdemalion* is ornate, and it leaves the deplorable state one shove from collapse.

entries.definition: ludicrously odd
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Odd to the point of being laughed at - the strangeness reads as clownish rather than menacing.

entries.definition: bizarre or fantastic
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Blunt and informal - it throws up its hands at the strangeness instead of examining it.

entries.definition: beyond or deviating from the usual or expected
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The oddness is inviting - it asks to be looked into, where *queer* asks to be backed away from.

entries.definition: inspiring a feeling of fear; strange and frightening
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The strangeness has turned frightening - it works on the nerves rather than on the judgement.
examples: an uncomfortable and eerie stillness in the woods

entries.definition: ludicrously odd
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Oddness inflated past what belief will carry, so the extravagance itself is the fault.

entries.definition: ludicrously odd
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The more elaborate twin of *fantastic* - the oddness sounds invented rather than merely met with.

entries.definition: beyond or deviating from the usual or expected
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Marks something as not quite right without saying what is wrong with it, and the vagueness is the unease.
examples: her speech has a funny twang
they have some funny ideas about war

entries.definition: ludicrously odd
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The harshest of these - the oddness is distorted enough to repel, where *antic* only invites laughter.
examples: a grotesque reflection in the mirror

entries.definition: beyond or deviating from the usual or expected
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The plain workhorse of this set - it registers the deviation flatly, with none of *peculiar*'s second look.

entries.definition: beyond or deviating from the usual or expected
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Fastens the oddness onto the thing itself, as a quality it owns rather than an impression it gives.
examples: the peculiar aromatic odor of cloves

entries.definition: beyond or deviating from the usual or expected
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Adds a wariness *odd* lacks - the deviation feels wrong rather than merely noticeable.
examples: something definitely queer about this town

entries.definition: beyond or deviating from the usual or expected
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Informal and offhand - the oddness gets a shrug rather than a verdict.

entries.definition: beyond or deviating from the usual or expected
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: A lighter, more throwaway ring than *rum*, the same shrug loosened further.

entries.definition: beyond or deviating from the usual or expected
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The one word here that flatters - deviation read as standing apart rather than as going wrong.

entries.definition: being definitely out of the ordinary and unexpected; slightly odd or even a bit weird
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Carries a faint edge of unease that *unusual* does not - what is strange is not merely rare but slightly off.
examples: a strange exaltation that was indefinable
what a strange sense of humor she has

entries.definition: being definitely out of the ordinary and unexpected; slightly odd or even a bit weird
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The flat member of the pair - it records a departure from the expected without *strange*'s hint that something is amiss.

entries.definition: of stone or timber; shaped roughly without finishing
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Flatter and more matter-of-fact than *roughhewn*, naming the cut alone without that word's suggestion of ruggedly worked bulk.

entries.definition: of stone or timber; shaped roughly without finishing
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Neutral about workmanship - the shaping has been done and only the finishing has not, where *unhewn* denies the shaping altogether.

entries.definition: of lumber or stone or hides; not finished or dressed
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Names one specific operation left undone rather than a general falling-short, which keeps it cooler and more technical than *unfinished*.

entries.definition: (of market animals) not optimal for marketing
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Coolly commercial disparagement - the animal is graded short of what the market wants, a deficiency stated as plain fact rather than complaint.

entries.definition: not brought to the desired final state
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Carries a faint reproach because the thing is measured against the final state that was wanted, so it records a shortfall rather than merely a stage.

entries.definition: (of stone especially) not given a finished form by or as if by hewing
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Denies the shaping outright where *roughhewn* concedes a first pass, and its as-if reach lets it settle on things no tool was ever near.
examples: a house of unhewn grey stone roughly cemented together

entries.definition: profoundly honored
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Lofty and formal - it raises the honor so high it puts distance between subject and speaker, where *honorable* stays level with you.

entries.definition: worthy of being honored; entitled to honor and respect
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The plain claim of the family - it certifies that respect is deserved, without the awe *august* and *venerable* pile on top.

entries.definition: worthy of being honored; entitled to honor and respect
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The British spelling, carrying exactly the same entitlement to respect as *honorable* with nothing added or softened.

entries.definition: worthy of the greatest honor or distinction
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Superlative - it does not merely grant honor but sets its object at the summit of it, where *honorable* only confirms the desert.
examples: The nation's pediatrician laureate is preparing to lay down his black bag

entries.definition: profoundly honored
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Locates the honor in those who feel it - the regard is actively given, not merely owed as with *honorable*.

entries.definition: honored because of age or long usage
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Approval with its grounds stated - the honor is credited to having lasted, where *honorable* and *venerable* name the honor without saying what earned it.

entries.definition: honored because of age or long usage
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The British spelling, endorsing a thing for its endurance in precisely the terms *time-honored* uses.

entries.definition: profoundly honored
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Solemn - it wraps the honor in a hush of reverence rather than the ceremonial elevation of *august*.

entries.definition: inspiring awe or admiration or wonder
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Unguarded warmth, all wonder and no weight, where *awe-inspiring* holds the same admiration at arm's length.
examples: New York is an amazing city

entries.definition: commanding attention
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Attention is seized and held - it stops you mid-stride, where *impressive* only invites you to admire at your leisure.
examples: an arresting drawing of people turning into animals

entries.definition: so surprisingly impressive as to stun or overwhelm
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Surprise is the mechanism here: it overwhelms because it exceeds what you were braced for, not because it is merely large.
examples: such an enormous response was astonishing

entries.definition: so surprisingly impressive as to stun or overwhelm
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: A heavier landing than *astonishing* - the surprise does not just register, it takes the ground out from under.

entries.definition: inspiring awe or admiration or wonder
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Formal, and it names the effect instead of voicing it - it reports what a thing does to an onlooker where *amazing* simply exclaims.
examples: the Grand Canyon is an awe-inspiring sight

entries.definition: inspiring awe or admiration or wonder
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The speaker's enthusiasm is as much on display as the thing admired, which is what makes it praise rather than description.
examples: the awesome complexity of the universe
